_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_raised: validate.py 1507 -> 1647: the fourteenth pack adds its structural, enumeration, kit-parity and mirror checks, and validate_counted_claims() gained three sources -- the two plugin manifests and package.json, which carried counts nothing read (marketplace.json said 'twelve pluggable style packs' above a list of thirteen for two releases). validate_palette.py 603 -> 716: datasheet declares two themes and a table base, so both halves' ratios and every stated claim are recomputed on every run. sloplint.py 352 -> 366: one more pack and token layer under the bans. Also validate_contract_split(): the core-contract paragraph's three numbers are now derived from the pack table rather than typed, because that remainder was stale in two consecutive pack releases and a scenario agent found it both times.
